gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will be treated with L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26 and Lomustine on Day 1 (in the evening after L19TNF infusion) of a 42-day cycle for up to a maximum of 6 cycles.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study With L19TNF in Combination With Lomustine in Patients With Glioblastoma at Progression or Recurrence

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetics assessment of L19TNF through blood sampling

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: further evaluate safety, efficacy, exposure, dose-response, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic information of the combination of L19TNF and lomustine at different dose levels

role_evidence.quote: Each arm has a different combination of L19TNF (7 μg/kg or 10 μg/kg or 13 μg/kg) and lomustine at different dose levels (90 or 110 mg/m2).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational immunocytokine (L19 antibody fused to TNF)

coder_notes: Dose-optimisation study: six randomised arms with three L19TNF doses and two lomustine doses, no control arm. L19TNF is the only investigational agent (experimental_monotherapy). Lomustine dose differs between arms, so rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment) applied under exception (i); if the adjudicator treats lomustine as plain backbone it would be soc_backbone, with no effect on candidate status. MGMT is a randomisation stratum (strata listed as bullet MGMT status); the stratum quote is the line introducing the strata list. MGMT promoter status must be known but no particular status is required. PK is blood sampling only. Pharmacodynamics is named as an objective without a described measurement.
